partners.mechanism_chain: PPM1K (HGNC:27099) —DISRUPTS→ Leucine catabolism (REACT:R-HSA-1487543); MCCC2 (HGNC:7001) —DISRUPTS→ 3-methylcrotonyl-CoA (CHEBI:17196); 3-methylcrotonyl-CoA (CHEBI:17196) —INCREASES→ Leucine catabolism (REACT:R-HSA-1487543); Leucine catabolism (REACT:R-HSA-1487543) —LEADS_TO→ Developmental delay (HP:0001263); Leucine catabolism (REACT:R-HSA-1487543) —LEADS_TO→ Hypotonia (HP:0011210); Leucine catabolism (REACT:R-HSA-1487543) —LEADS_TO→ Seizures (HP:0001250). Mutations in PPM1K (for MONDO:0014057) and MCCC2 (for MONDO:0008862) both disrupt the downstream metabolic pathway of leucine catabolism. Loss-of-function in MCCC2 directly impairs the conversion of 3-methylcrotonyl-CoA, leading to its accumulation. While the exact role of PPM1K in this pathway is less characterized, it is known to be involved, and its disruption likely contributes to the dysregulation of leucine catabolism, potentially by affecting substrate availability or enzyme activity, ultimately leading to shared phenotypes like developmental delay, hypotonia, and seizures.
